_doc: Reward penalty weights and curriculum gates for sim/streetball (read by sim/streetball/reward_config.py). Mirrored by the Unreal DataAsset UStreetballRewardConfig (unreal/StreetballGym/Source/StreetballGym/StreetballRewardConfig.h); keep both equal (sim/tests/test_reward_config.py). Weights are added to the reward as weight * term, so penalties are negative. foot_slip was added on 2026-11-20: the shipped policies in shared/policies were trained before it and were NOT retrained.

terms.joint_ang_vel_sq: mean over hinge joints of qvel^2 (rad/s)^2
terms.foot_slip: sum over feet of contact * planar foot speed^2 (m/s)^2
